en_title: Gears of War E-Day is a 'Natural Choice to Be an Exclusive' – Studio Head Mike Crump Claims Series Carries The Banner For Xbox
cn_title: 《战争机器：事变日》独占是自然之选
subtitle: 为XBOX扛旗
opus_summary: The Coalition工作室负责人Mike Crump称，《战争机器：事变日》由XBOX独占是自然之选。团队不仅看销量和玩家留存率，还希望借游戏展示XBOX硬件的能力，让玩家有理由留在该平台生态中。

paragraphs.en: Gears of War: E-Day launched this week, and while it is excellent, the game was pulled away from a PS5 launch earlier this year. But, in a recent interview, The Coalition Studio Head Mike Crump claims that this was all part of the plan.
paragraphs.cn: 《战争机器：事变日》本周发售，游戏表现出色，但今年早些时候，它被撤出了PS5发行计划。The Coalition工作室负责人Mike Crump近日接受采访时称，这一切都在计划之中。

paragraphs.en: In an interview with the BBC , Crump defended the choice to be an Xbox exclusive, despite a likely ludicrous budget sayig, "Gears has been an exclusive franchise to Xbox for 20 years now. It's sort of entwined deeply with the brand."
paragraphs.cn: 尽管这款游戏的预算可能高得惊人，Crump在接受BBC采访时仍为XBOX独占的决定辩护：「《战争机器》系列作为XBOX独占作品已有20年，可以说它与这个品牌紧密相连。」

paragraphs.en: However, Gears of War: Reloaded did launch on PS5 last year, so the franchise as a whole isn't exactly Xbox-exclusive anymore. It's also likely that if E-Day did launch on Playstation, it'd see higher sales numbers.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，《战争机器：重装上阵》去年确实登陆了PS5，因此整个《战争机器》系列已不能完全算是XBOX独占。如果《战争机器：事变日》也登陆PlayStation，销量很可能会更高。

paragraphs.en: Crump claims that the metrics for success go further than that, though. He told the BBC that the series is meant to, at least in part, carry the banner for the Xbox platform and give people a "reason to be in the Xbox ecosystem." Queue Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's decision to pull the game from the PS5 release slate.
paragraphs.cn: 但Crump认为，衡量成功不能只看销量。他告诉BBC，《战争机器》系列的使命至少有一部分是为XBOX平台扛旗，给人们一个「留在XBOX生态中的理由」。这也就有了XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma将游戏撤出PS5发行计划的决定。

paragraphs.en: But, regardless, the game will now likely have lower sales than it otherwise would have. When the BBC asked Crump about that, he insisted that the studio is taking a broader view than just looking at sales figures and retention numbers.
paragraphs.cn: 但无论如何，这款游戏如今的销量很可能低于登陆PS5时的水平。BBC就此询问Crump时，他强调，工作室衡量游戏表现的角度更广，不只是看销量和玩家留存率。

paragraphs.en: "We measure things like, are we showcasing the platform? Are we pushing the hardware to it limits? Are we showcasing what the Xbox is capable of? ...Our goal basically is to be the best-looking game on the Xbox and really show the industry what's possible with our hardware," he answered.
paragraphs.cn: 他回答道：「我们会考虑这些问题：有没有展示出平台的实力？有没有把硬件推向极限？有没有展示XBOX能做到什么？……我们的目标基本上是做出XBOX上画面最出色的游戏，真正向业界展示我们的硬件能实现什么。」

paragraphs.en: Well, if the goal is to be a tech demo about what the Xbox consoles are capable of, I'd argue that it's a straight-up success. The game looks incredible on both the Xbox Series X and Series S, so much so that The Coalition had to rely on trickery with the Page File to get the game running smoothly on the less-powerful console. The game is also incredible, and our reviewer Ryan McCaffrey gave it a 9 , saying:
paragraphs.cn: 如果目标是把游戏做成展示XBOX主机性能的技术演示，我认为它无疑成功了。无论在XBOX Series X还是Series S上，游戏画面都令人惊叹；为了让它在性能较弱的Series S上流畅运行，The Coalition甚至不得不在页面文件（Page File）上使些巧妙手段。游戏本身同样出色，IGN评测编辑Ryan McCaffrey给出了9分，并写道：

paragraphs.en: "By going back to the beginning, Gears of War: E-Day returns to the heart of this series: Marcus Fenix, Dom Santiago, and a Locust horde that’s as terrifying as it is dangerous. E-Day pulls off the tightrope act of giving us a heartfelt prequel with strong characters even when we know how it ends. On a more mechanical level, it also evolves the enemies, weapons, and combat you’d expect to deliver a Gears of War campaign that stands toe-to-toe with any of the others. It wraps up with 10 years still left to go before Marcus gets tossed in prison ahead of the events of the first Gears of War, so here’s hoping the next one stays in the past for a while longer – and that we don’t have to wait another seven years for it to arrive."
paragraphs.cn: 「《战争机器：事变日》回到故事的起点，也回到了系列的核心：马库斯·菲尼克斯、多姆·圣地亚哥，以及既骇人又危险的兽族大军。即使我们知道故事的结局，《战争机器：事变日》仍成功写出一部情感真挚、人物鲜明的前传，拿捏好了其中的分寸。在玩法上，它也让系列玩家熟悉的敌人、武器和战斗更进一步，带来一场足以与系列其他作品比肩的《战争机器》战役。故事结束时，距离马库斯在初代《战争机器》事件发生前入狱还有10年。因此，希望下一部作品能继续讲述这段过去的故事，也希望我们不用再等上7年。」

paragraphs.en: Let's just hope that a pretty game and high review scores really are enough to keep the Xbox layoff machine at bay.
paragraphs.cn: 但愿出色的画面和亮眼的评测分数，真能让XBOX暂时停下裁员的脚步。
